summary: mataroa is a Django micro-blogging SaaS where each User gets a subdomain-based blog; they CRUD Posts, Pages and Images (via web forms + a Bearer-token JSON API), publish/schedule by setting published_at, moderate reader Comments, subscribe/unsubscribe Newsletter subscribers, and pay via Stripe (premium upgrades author-approved). Analysts/visits are recorded as AnalyticPage/AnalyticPost rows; scheduled jobs emit newsletter emails (NotificationRecord), monthly markdown exports (ExportRecord), and renewal reminders; superusers moderate all Users. A login creates the account via the Onboard invitation code.
